meta.name: capacity-planner
meta.description: Headcount and delivery-capacity planning — effective capacity from raw headcount, hire/contract/defer scenarios, and capacity-vs-commitment gap reports. Use when planning a quarter, sizing a hiring ask, or testing whether a roadmap fits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把人力数字换算成可用交付容量,看清差距
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在规划季度或招聘前,想先确认团队容量够不够
copy.tagline_en: Turn headcount into deliverable capacity and see the gap
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you plan quarters or hiring and need to know if your team can deliver

howto.what: 把团队成员名单、请假、会议耗时等信息换算成真正能承诺交付的工时;再对照带风险系数的需求,告诉你哪些排不进计划,并比较招聘、外包、延后三种补缺口方案。会先问清关键假设再出结果。
howto.when: 当你做季度规划、评估招聘需求,或想验证路线图是否排得下时触发;临时重排、评估新人影响等也适用。

say.text: 帮我按这份七人名单算一下本季度的有效工时
say.note: 会先确认输入,再给出每人及每个工种的有效工时

say.text: 对比招聘、外包、延后三个方案来补这个缺口
say.note: 输出每个方案的时间和成本对比及建议

say.text: 这些承诺里有哪些排不进计划?
say.note: 按优先级填充容量,列出排不下的部分

howto.what_en: Converts roster, leave, meeting load, and overhead into committable hours; matches risk-adjusted demand against capacity, reports what falls below the cut line, and compares hire/contract/defer scenarios. Asks clarifying questions first.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you are planning a quarter, sizing a hiring ask, or testing whether a roadmap fits; also for mid-quarter replans and onboarding-impact modeling.

say_en.text: Calculate effective capacity for this quarter from this roster.
say_en.note: It asks for missing inputs, then outputs effective hours per person/discipline.

say_en.text: Compare hire, contract, and defer options to close the gap.
say_en.note: Shows time-to-relief, cost per delivered hour, reversibility, and retention.

say_en.text: Which commitments fall below the cut line?
say_en.note: Fills capacity by priority and lists what does not fit.
